import json, glob
for f in sorted(glob.glob('events/event-*.json'))[:6]:
    j=json.load(open(f)); print(f, j.get('kind'), j.get('source'))
    if j.get('kind')=='MessageEvent':
        c=j['llm_message'].get('content')
        t=c[0].get('text') if isinstance(c,list) and c else str(c)
        print('   ', t[:200].replace('\n',' '))
EOF
